mapper.select: SELECT DATE(payments.confirmed_at) AS date, SUM(payments.amount) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS paidSessionCount FROM payments INNER JOIN sales_sessions ON sales_sessions.id = payments.sales_session_id WHERE sales_sessions.store_id = #{storeId} AND payments.status = 'PAID' AND payments.confirmed_at >= #{from} AND payments.confirmed_at < #{to} GROUP BY DATE(payments.confirmed_at) ORDER BY DATE(payments.confirmed_at) ASC

SELECT dates.date, COALESCE(paid.paidSessionCount, 0) AS paidSessionCount, waits.averageWaitMinutes FROM ( SELECT DATE(payments.confirmed_at) AS date FROM payments INNER JOIN sales_sessions ON sales_sessions.id = payments.sales_session_id WHERE sales_sessions.store_id = #{storeId} AND payments.status = 'PAID' AND payments.confirmed_at >= #{from} AND payments.confirmed_at < #{to} UNION SELECT DATE(orders.created_at) AS date FROM orders INNER JOIN sales_sessions ON sales_sessions.id = orders.sales_session_id INNER JOIN order_items ON order_items.order_id = orders.id WHERE sales_sessions.store_id = #{storeId} AND orders.created_at >= #{from} AND orders.created_at < #{to} AND order_items.served_at IS NOT NULL ) dates LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(payments.confirmed_at) AS date, COUNT(*) AS paidSessionCount FROM payments INNER JOIN sales_sessions ON sales_sessions.id = payments.sales_session_id WHERE sales_sessions.store_id = #{storeId} AND payments.status = 'PAID' AND payments.confirmed_at >= #{from} AND payments.confirmed_at < #{to} GROUP BY DATE(payments.confirmed_at) ) paid ON paid.date = dates.date LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(orders.created_at) AS date, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, orders.created_at, order_items.served_at) / 60.0) AS averageWaitMinutes FROM order_items INNER JOIN orders ON orders.id = order_items.order_id INNER JOIN sales_sessions ON sales_sessions.id = orders.sales_session_id WHERE sales_sessions.store_id = #{storeId} AND orders.created_at >= #{from} AND orders.created_at < #{to} AND order_items.served_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DATE(orders.created_at) ) waits ON waits.date = dates.date ORDER BY dates.date ASC

SELECT order_items.menu_item_id AS menuItemId, order_items.item_name AS name, SUM(order_items.quantity - COALESCE(cancellations.cancelledQuantity, 0)) AS soldQuantity, SUM((order_items.unit_price + order_items.options_amount) * (order_items.quantity - COALESCE(cancellations.cancelledQuantity, 0))) AS revenue, SUM(COALESCE(cancellations.remadeQuantity, 0)) AS remadeQuantity FROM order_items INNER JOIN orders ON orders.id = order_items.order_id INNER JOIN sales_sessions ON sales_sessions.id = orders.sales_session_id INNER JOIN payments ON payments.sales_session_id = sales_sessions.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT order_item_cancellation_requests.order_item_id AS orderItemId, SUM(CASE WHEN order_item_cancellation_requests.status = 'APPROVED' THEN order_item_cancellation_requests.requested_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS cancelledQuantity, SUM(CASE WHEN order_item_cancellation_requests.status = 'APPROVED' AND order_item_cancellation_requests.is_remade THEN order_item_cancellation_requests.requested_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS remadeQuantity FROM order_item_cancellation_requests GROUP BY order_item_cancellation_requests.order_item_id ) cancellations ON cancellations.orderItemId = order_items.id WHERE sales_sessions.store_id = #{storeId} AND payments.status = 'PAID' AND payments.confirmed_at >= #{from} AND payments.confirmed_at < #{to} AND (orders.note IS NULL OR orders.note NOT LIKE '[LÀM LẠI]%') GROUP BY order_items.menu_item_id, order_items.item_name ORDER BY soldQuantity DESC, revenue DESC, name ASC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN promotions.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (promotions.start_at IS NULL OR promotions.start_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) AND (promotions.end_at IS NULL OR promotions.end_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS active, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN promotions.status = 'ACTIVE' AND promotions.start_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS upcoming, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN promotions.status = 'ACTIVE' AND promotions.end_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS expired, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN promotions.status IN ('DRAFT', 'INACTIVE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS inactive FROM promotions WHERE promotions.store_id = #{storeId}
